record.name: Brex
record.one_liner: Brex provides a REST API utilizing Bearer user tokens to manage corporate cards, expenses, travel, accounting data, and custom workflows.

auth.notes: Uses a user token passed in request headers as 'Authorization: Bearer {{your user_token here}}'.

access.notes: Requires being a Brex customer with admin access to the Brex dashboard to generate user tokens.

api_surface.notes: APIs use REST architecture, are defined using OpenAPI specifications, accept/return JSON, and require HTTPS.

buildability.reasoning: Requires an existing Brex customer account with admin access to generate tokens, but provides straightforward REST endpoints and a quickstart guide.

evidence.claim: Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification, and support Webhooks API.
To authenticate, generate a user token from the Brex dashboard and pass it as a Bearer token in headers.
Quickstart guide assumes you are a Brex customer with admin access to generate your user token.
